decisions.reason: The passenger data transmission solution builds directly on the firm's core aviation and APIS know-how and has strong quantified use by the UK Home Office and over 30 government schemes, so the firm can interpret its results and keep improving it.

Demand for travel health rules is fading and no results are reported, but the API builds on the firm's passenger data and document expertise and can be absorbed into the related verification platforms, so the firm keeps it for now despite high uncertainty.
The cyber awareness module uses the firm's certified-trainer capabilities at low cost, though weak visibility and no reported results limit what the firm can learn from it.
The behaviour analysis system extends the firm's established behavioural detection expertise, giving it the related knowledge to absorb feedback and refine the product.
The passenger profiling method is rooted in the firm's core aviation screening knowledge, so it is a natural extension the firm can learn from and improve.
The document verification platform sits close to the firm's airline document-check offer and complements Product A, so the firm can readily interpret its market results and apply them.
